earlier_scan.source_named: Laoust, E. 1912. Etude sur le dialecte berbere du Chenoua compare avec ceux des Beni-Menacer et des Beni-Salah. Paris: Leroux.

sources.citation: Destaing, Edmond. 1907. Etude sur le dialecte berbère des Beni-Snous. Tome I. (Publications de l'École des Lettres d'Alger, Bulletin de correspondance africaine XXXIV.) Paris: Ernest Leroux. [Tome II, 1911]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage), call number 2245.60)
sources.note: Marks accent diacritically on every transcribed word (p. 2 vowel table: 'â, ô, ê long et accentué; ā, ō, ē long et non accentué; á, ó, é bref et accentué; ă.. très bref') and says (p. 2 n. 2) that isolated nouns were accented as if pronounced phrase-finally as direct objects; p. 192 notes that when gemination changes between sg. and pl. 'l'accent est alors modifié' (áḫḫām / iḫámměn). No rule of accent placement is stated; his marked forms show accent variously initial, penultimate, antepenultimate (árgāz ~ írgāzěn, afûnas ~ ifûnāsěn, iḍáṛṛěn).

sources.citation: Laoust, Emile (1912). Etude sur le dialecte du Chenoua comparé avec des beni-menacer et des beni-salah. Paris: Ernest Leroux. 197 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; also in print at Harvard (Widener Library, call number 2245.59; Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number L.SOC.3.3.5 (50); Widener Library)
sources.harvard_location: Widener Library, call number 2245.59; Tozzer Library (offsite storage), call number L.SOC.3.3.5 (50); Widener Library
sources.note: Language not in the catalog and no existing statements; Laoust adds nothing on stress. Describes Chenoua with comparative data from Beni Menacer and Beni Salah, all within chen1266.
